{"type":"text","text":"# Work unit U-0001

Rules: bump_standard

## Files in the unit

### CMakeLists.txt

```cmake
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21

edits.replace: std::find_if(found, counts.end(), [threshold](int count) { return count < threshold; })
~Transaction() noexcept(false);  // may throw RollbackError, see above

arguments.summary: Build at C++20: drop the home-made nullptr for the keyword, rename the char16_t typedef, remove register and auto storage classes, convert streams to bool explicitly, cast the narrowing Money initializer, space out the PRId64 literals, replace ptr_fun and bind2nd with lambdas, and let Transaction's destructor keep throwing RollbackError.
review_notes: Transaction's destructor is noexcept(false): it throws RollbackError for a strict transaction destroyed without commit(), which the tests check, and C++11 destructors are noexcept by default, so it would have called std::terminate instead.
Public API: ledger::char16_t is now ledger::utf16_unit (still unsigned short); char16_t is a keyword since C++11. Utf16 keeps its element type.
compat.h no longer defines the C++98 nullptr class; the keyword replaces it. LEDGER_STATIC_ASSERT and LEDGER_NONCOPYABLE still compile and are left for a later modernization.
scale() truncates toward zero as before: the brace initializer needed an explicit static_cast<long> under C++11's narrowing rules.
